text: AugmentedTopologyMarker is an option for FCLoopTensorReduce, FCLoopAugmentTopology and other functions. It marks topologies (written as GLIs denoting denominators only) that need to be augmented with propagators containing the given external momenta. This case usually occurs when doing a tensor reduction with zero Gram determinant and light-like external momenta, so that an auxiliary vector must be added to the basis.
